title: Chapter 316 The Red Lantern Is Watching You
content:
Chapter 316 The Red Lantern Is Watching You

Quiet, incomparably silent.

The two other samurai next to the samurai were stunned, and the ordinary villagers behind the two samurai were also stunned when they saw the samurai's body.

The horror in their hearts, as well as the incomparable fear, deeply filled every corner of their bodies.

No one would have thought that the samurai who had shown his supernatural power just now, who seemed to be able to kill the monster in front of him easily, would be killed by such a direct move by the monster.

The death was crisp and neat, without even making a sound.

"At any rate, you should return two or three moves, and do some dynamic and static load tests! It's easy to be wiped out like this, so how can we fight it down!"

The two warriors next to the dead warrior cursed secretly in their hearts.

Their strength was not as good as the dead warriors, otherwise they would not have acted as deputy and obeyed his orders.

Now seeing that the samurai who was stronger than him had died, the pressure in the hearts of the remaining two people had skyrocketed.

This can be seen from the fact that they are slightly whitish, even with a hint of blue, their facial muscles are completely stiff, the teeth in their mouths tremble slightly, and the hands holding the samurai sword can't help but twitch, shaking a little. These performances can show how much psychological pressure they have.

The samurai just now died too quickly. One second he was still in sight of victory, but the next second he was lying dead on the ground.

This gap between front and back made it hard for them to accept.

However, they didn't wait for them to feel in their hearts that the warrior leader died aggrieved and a little cowardly.

Roar.

The monster let out a beast cry, and rushed towards the two warriors with great power. The unstoppable momentum rushed towards the two warriors, causing their hearts to tremble.

The monster's movements were the same as before, with the same ferocious and quick movements, and it crossed several meters in the blink of an eye, and it didn't take long to reach the front of the two warriors.

"Damn it, this demon came here so quickly!"

The two warriors cursed secretly, feeling more and more frightened in their hearts.

But now there is no time for them to feel emotional, the two looked at each other, and saw the determination and fear in each other's eyes.

After all, they are warriors who have been fought on the battlefield, and each of them has the intuition that these dozens of lives have been tempered between life and death to tell them.

The more powerful the enemy is, the more fearful you are, the less you can retreat.

On the contrary, he has to bravely attack this powerful enemy and use his own life to win this battle.

Only in this way can they have a chance to survive.

Choking sound.

The two samurai pulled out the katana swords in their hands, and looked at the monster running towards them. They moved swiftly, lined up on the left and right, and quickly greeted the monster.

They are skillful in their movements, with a rhythmic step on their feet, and the long knife in their hands makes a sharp sound of breaking the wind. After this set of movements, it turned out to be an extremely simple and effective combination attack method.

Even with Zhong Yu's gaze, he had to feel admiration.

With their strength, they can quickly display this combined attack formation, which can indeed be called an elite.

Soon, in three or four seconds, the two warriors came into contact with the demon.

The two sides handed over and passed by, with a few puffs, bringing up several bloody lights.

The monster was actually wounded several times by the two warriors' joint attack. His whole body was ripped apart, and the bright red muscles still exuded heat under the air, and pools of blood flowed down, which was quite frightening.

However, the miserable appearance of the monster in front of him did not make the two warriors who caused all this relax and feel happy.

Even the group of ignorant villagers behind them didn't look happy at all, instead their expressions became more and more fearful and dignified.

With the precedent of the previous warrior leader, no matter how optimistic and ignorant they are, they still know that the more injured this monster is, the stronger it becomes.

If he really relaxed his vigilance because of the 32 of this monster, then he would be defenseless under the soaring strength of the monster.

I'm afraid I'm going to follow in the footsteps of the previous warrior leader and confess my good life.

The demon screamed more and more.

However, following the demon's screams, his figure became more and more swollen, and the muscles all over his body became tighter and tighter. When his legs stepped on the ground, the ground could not help shaking slightly.

Under the serious injury of this party, the strength of the monster has become stronger and stronger.

Regardless of the injuries on his body, he overdrawn his body's potential, and he wanted to exchange for powerful strength to tear the two warriors who dared to hurt him in front of him.

The faces of the two warriors became paler, and the fear in their hearts became even greater. However, their determination to die became more and more intense in their eyes.

The two of them had a vague premonition, and they were afraid that they had to explain here.

However, with the dignity of a warrior, even if you die, you can't just give up resistance. They want to leave enough scars on their enemy to let him know that even if they die, it won't make him feel better.

The samurai's hand holding the handle of the knife couldn't help but tightened more and more tightly.

While crying, the monster rushed towards the two warriors with a more ferocious aura and faster speed.

Because of the monster's huge body, the strong wind that came one step ahead pierced the faces of the two warriors with slight pain, making the hearts of the two of them even colder.

However, the two bravely went forward.

The two sides came and went, and swords and swords flashed from time to time during the melee, and there were streaks of blood, and there were continuous shouts of anger and bursts of mourning.

Not long, about ten minutes.

The monster stood where he was, and there were already two corpses lying under his feet, which were obviously two warriors.

The loss of all three samurai, for the villagers in the village, is tantamount to their sky falling, all panicked and at a loss.

"God Amaterasu, have you abandoned your people? Even three such powerful warriors died under the hands of this monster. Is our village doomed to be destroyed today?"

At the gate of the village, there was a middle-aged man who was dressed more decently than other villagers around him, and had a trace of majesty in his demeanor. Kneeling on the ground, holding the wet soil with both hands, tears streaming down his eyes, he cried hoarsely and mournfully.

His voice resonated with the villagers around him, making the villagers look even more desperate and sad.

However, besides causing pain to the villagers, his voice also awakened the demon in the distance and made him turn his gaze.

I saw the demon's red eyes, like a big red lantern, staring closely at the villagers at the entrance of the village, his eyes exuded coldness and strong malicious murderous intent.
